docs: Fixed 32-byte little-endian params followed by a 16-byte client order ID. Flags: bit 0 refreshes regions, bit 1 overrides the sequence number, bit 2 sets updateSlot, bit 3 sets bidWidth, and bit 4 sets askWidth. instructions.name: uncrossCrank
docs: Cranks the orderbook to uncross any crossed orders.

Returns a fixed 128-byte little-endian UncrossCrankReturn after event logging. Version 1: flags bit 0 indicates bestBidTicks is present, bit 1 indicates bestAskTicks is present; absent sides are zero. Includes post-crank mark/index prices and their update slots, matching Hawkeye price semantics. Padding and reserved words are zero; future flags may assign optional reserved fields. Readers validate magic/version and ignore unknown flags and reserved words. A bounded crank may leave a crossed BBO.

definedTypes.name: liquidateSpotParams
docs: MaxSpotAmount is the amount of spot collateral, in the token's native units, the liquidator takes over; numTradersToCheck counts the leading remaining accounts used as shortfall evidence; packedInstructions are venue instructions executed via CPI against the trailing venue accounts.

definedTypes.name: packedInstruction
docs: Caller-provided CPI instruction whose accounts index into the trailing venue accounts.

definedTypes.name: packedAccountMeta
docs: Single-byte packed account meta: bits 7..2 = account index into the trailing venue accounts, bit 1 = is_signer, bit 0 = is_writable.

definedTypes.name: setSpotAssetPriceInstruction
docs: Borsh payload for recording a spot-collateral price. The exponent must equal the
asset's configured price exponent; the symbol is cross-checked against the entry
at the asset index.

definedTypes.name: changeSpotAssetParamsInstruction
docs: Borsh payload updating selected fields in a spot asset's oracle-price configuration;
Some(default pubkey) disables proxy price writes and None leaves that field unchanged.

docs: Optional instruction suffix; Borsh enum with u8 rates in tenths of a basis point. Omit the suffix for zero fees.
